initialExam.title: AAI Junior Executive 2026
initialExam.description: AAI recruits Junior Executives for airport management, ATC, electronics, and engineering roles at airports across India.
initialExam.eligibility: B.E./B.Tech in relevant discipline or equivalent
initialExam.syllabus: Technical: Domain-specific (Electronics/Electrical/Civil/ATC). Non-technical: English, Reasoning, Quant, GA.
initialExam.examPattern: Online CBT: 120 questions, 120 marks. No negative marking for some posts.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Online Test → Document Verification → Medical → Final Selection
initialExam.jobRole: Junior Executive in airports for ATC, electronics, engineering, and management
initialExam.careerGrowth: JE → Senior Executive → Manager → GM → ED.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit aai.aero 2. Register 3. Apply 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Medical, LTC, Airport allowance, Housing
